sceneDescription: On a supermarket checkout belt, a shiny gold ring perches atop a stack of shipping boxes, which are themselves riding on a miniature warehouse robot. Next to them, a judge's gavel sits oddly among packing tape and barcode scanners. The robot, slightly scuffed, features a subtle sticker with the Digital Commerce 360 logo. The gold ring sports a tiny Chow Tai Fook tag, while a Practical Ecommerce logo is barely visible on a shopping bag peeking from behind a box. The arrangement is absurdly logical: luxury and regulation meet gritty logistics, all in a mundane retail setting.
